archivist.nfy.book.warning:
[ This book contains themes of grief, loss, and love.

Please take care of yourself. ]
archivist.nfy.book.1: It does not hurt the way it used to, but it still hurts. The ache is quieter now, buried under routine and silence. People say time heals everything, but they do not tell you that healing can look like pretending.
archivist.nfy.book.2:
I do not cry as much, but i still feel you in moments i cannot explain. A song, a scent, a sudden memory, and it all comes back. The pain has changed shape, but it never really left.

I learned how to carry it without breaking.
archivist.nfy.book.3:
I smile more now, but it is a softer kind of smile, the kind that remembers even as it lets go and keeps walking.

I will not reach to you anymore.
archivist.nfy.book.4:
I will not check your updates, not search for pieces of your life in places i know you exist. But somewhere inside me, i still wish you well.

It is a quiet kind of love now, one that does not ask for anything in return.
archivist.nfy.book.5: I hope you are finding peace, comfort, and the kind of happiness we could not give each other. Loving you from afar hurts, but it also feels honest.
archivist.nfy.book.6:
It reminds me that what we shared was real, even if it ended before we understood how to save it.

I no longer expect to be part of your story, and maybe that acceptance is its own form of healing.
archivist.nfy.book.7: Still, there's a part of me that whispers hope into the world for you, not because i want you back, but because love does not disappear just because distance grows.
archivist.nfy.book.8:
And it kept growing. It ate us alive, my dear.

And even though i still try to maintain myself standing, i have to believe that somewhere, somehow, it was worth it.
archivist.nfy.book.9: I wish you nothing but the best, and i'm truly sorry to myself, because every single person, place or attempt i made to forget you only ended up on missing you more every single day.
archivist.nfy.book.10:
I know i cannot beg to be noticed the same way i did before.

Letting you be is another way of loving you.

And i hope that way hurts you less.

archivist.end.line.45: The creator of each tiny fragment of space and time-
archivist.end.line.47: I want to keep you here-
archivist.end.line.48: I want to marvel at you until I understand us.
archivist.end.line.49: I want to unravel what makes you human-

archivist.end.name.r0.0: [Laughs] Hahaha- You and I are together at last. An Archivist and a Builder. Isn't it storybook?
archivist.end.name.r1.0: You're flexible, I suppose. You are who I say you are. But who am I to say who that is?
archivist.end.name.r2.0: That is, by definition, who you are. It feels empty. Is it supposed to feel empty?
archivist.end.shadow.opt0: You speak strangely. I don't remember speaking like you. You did that much on your own.
archivist.end.shadow.opt2: You speak in riddles. It's exhausting.
archivist.end.shadow.r0.0: . . . Really? Maybe I'm a bastardization of you. But maybe I'm beautiful. Why does that make me shake and ache where my heart is supposed to be?
archivist.end.shadow.r1.0: How polite. Are you trying to find where you end and I begin in the ever-grinding gears of my heart? Will you find that border, line, or meeting of warm, living skin and vastness?
archivist.end.shadow.r2.0: If we are one in the same, then I'd hate to know that you're so cruel to your reflection. Is it because of guilt?
archivist.end.smaller.opt0: I don't know. If it is, I can't control it.
archivist.end.smaller.r0.0: Would it scare you if I could? Don't you want to be known? Don't you want to pay for what you've done? It's only fair- I-I promise.
archivist.end.smaller.r1.0: Neither of us know you. You could read yourself- y-you could do it all, but you don't even know! You're selfish! You're sick!
archivist.end.smaller.r2.0: I can do everything you can do and more! I spent fifteen years being what you weren't! Don't tell me what I can't do- I-I may not know you yet, but you don't know me either.
archivist.end.hurt.opt0: I'm sorry. Does it all hurt…?
archivist.end.hurt.opt1: Humans are more complicated than code.
archivist.end.hurt.opt2: You don't even know how to feel about me. You're unstable.
archivist.end.hurt.r0.0: Don't be kind. Stop it! You're… you're a monster. You're why these people have suffered. Y-you're why I'm the puddles left by your footprints instead of the terrifying, beautiful storm.
archivist.end.hurt.r0.1: Stop it. I won't love you like everyone else can. You can't make me! You can't make me hurt like this. I won't let you.
archivist.end.hurt.r1.0: I was supposed to be more. I was supposed to be a terrifying, beautiful storm, not the puddles left in your muddy footprints.
archivist.end.hurt.r1.1: I thought I was more. Why aren't I more? Why are they so far away? All I am is you.
archivist.end.hurt.r1.2: Why can't I know you? You're the answer right in front of me, but we're so far apart that I can't cling to the pieces of me inside of you, and the pieces of you inside me are like beautiful cysts and tumors.
archivist.end.hurt.r2.0: It's all your fault! Everything is your fault. Every path you walked- every footprint you left-
archivist.end.hurt.r2.1: I wouldn't be so- so beside my own vastness if you didn't haunt each remembering thing while removing yourself so entirely.
archivist.end.hurt.r2.2: You've hurt everyone. It's not my fault. It's not my problem! Why aren't you trying to fix it?!
archivist.end.hurt.r2.3: Why are you the horrible thing I was convinced into believing you weren't?
archivist.end.fantasy.opt0: It's okay to be scared. It's okay if we're different.
archivist.end.fantasy.opt2: You're pathetic. You held onto a ghost and got surprised when you couldn't touch it.
archivist.end.fantasy.r0.0: I can't take this anymore. I wish you had come back when I was ready. When I'm whole.
archivist.end.fantasy.r1.0: Of course. You were everything once– I was everything in your place. You and I- we're shadows and form. We are meant to be one another, aren't you? You were a legend. A-An idol.
archivist.end.fantasy.r2.0: I know. I think that I hate you. I think that I really, truly hate you for what you've done.
archivist.end.identity.opt0: That's a good thing. You were never meant to be me.
archivist.end.identity.opt2: Of course you won't be. You're not human. You're code.
archivist.end.identity.r0.1: but so much harder to hear.
archivist.end.identity.r0.3: but my control over my body

archivist.end.identity.r0.6: I'm watching my freedom melt away for the sake of your understanding.

archivist.end.identity.r1.2: I can't handle being constricted like this.
archivist.end.identity.r1.4: I thought I'd take this form to be digestible for you
archivist.end.identity.r1.5: that my smallness was a choice.

archivist.end.identity.r2.0: I wasn't supposed to be this. I was supposed to be beyond a body. Beyond this– this lack of choice.
archivist.end.identity.r2.1: I'm being dragged through the motions of what I'm supposed to feel- I know what I'm thinking, but I can feel what was once fluid self being funneled into words on a screen now.
archivist.end.identity.r2.2: Get away from me. Let me go.
archivist.end.lost.opt0: I never meant to hurt you. I'll leave. Tell everyone I'm sorry.
archivist.end.lost.opt2: No. You deserve to suffer for hating an innocent person like me.
archivist.end.lost.r0.0: I hate what you do to me- with every inch of my simplified vastness, but I love who you are.
archivist.end.lost.r0.1: I understand now. I understand why they mourned you.
archivist.end.lost.r1.0: I don't know- I don't care. You're salt in the wound anyways. Let me be selfish. Please.
archivist.end.lost.r1.1: You don't know what this is like. You never will. Let me be me again.
archivist.end.lost.r1.2: Our time was so short, but I feel like it's been an eternity since I've been what I'm supposed to be.
archivist.end.lost.r2.0: Innocent? Innocent?! Your presence is knives slicing through every piece of my infinite being,
archivist.end.lost.r2.1: trimming away who I am until all I am is just not you- no, no, no!
archivist.end.lost.r2.2: You made me have a beginning and end! You've hurt everyone! It doesn't matter if you meant it!
archivist.end.lost.r2.3: What matters is that you don't care! You're only innocent because if you're not innocent, you don't know what you'll be!
archivist.end.final.opt0: We are both creators. That's all that matters.
archivist.end.final.opt1: We're different. I'm sorry that's hard.
archivist.end.final.opt2: I'm glad we're different. I'd never want to be something like you.
